title: Unit Event — Walk on and on — Episode5 Where I Belong

meta.Event Outline: In preparation for their next event, Vivid BAD SQUAD, Arata and the others set out to write different songs based on a single theme. Akito and An take on the duty of making the new track, but Toya wishes that he could contribute to lighten their load.

rows.Line: Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do I need to do in order to create songs like the ones Soma does? How do I achieve that compelling sound...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Helping him has been a great learning experience. I feel like I've gained so many new skills.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Unfortunately, I'm still missing something. But I have no idea what that is...)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: So, for your first step, you might want to try figuring that out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What I want to convey...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I thought I'd learned recently to understand my feelings better thanks to Akito and the others, but it seems there's still more for me to unpack.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What am I feeling? What do I want my song to be about...?
A few days later
Hospital

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Humhumhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You seem to love music very much, Soma.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Huh? Yeah, I guess I do.
Music's been in my life forever it feels.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Forever...?
Do your parents happen to play music?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Not really, but they really like reggae and jazz. It's usually being played at my house 24/7.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I guess it's only natural that I'd also get into music. That was a big influence, but I started out hooked on pop.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, so you didn't immediately dive right into street music? To be fair, I'm the same...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Hahahah. True that, classical boy!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I actually bought an instrument when I was still in elementary school. Unfortunately, on top of getting bored of things pretty easily, I had to teach myself how to play it. As a result, I didn't get very far with it.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: That was around the time I decided to visit Vivid Street and just happened to catch RADder putting on a street performance.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
RADder...!
You saw Ken and his team put on a street performance?!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah, there were a ton of people watching too. I couldn't just walk by without stopping to see what was going on.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: And their music was so different from anything I'd heard before. I was completely staggered by how exciting it was.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That must've been incredible...
I'm very envious of you. By the time I began visiting Vivid Street, Ken and his team weren't performing there anymore.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Apparently, it was pretty rare for them to do street performances. Then, all these people began to gather, and they ended up calling it after just one song.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wow. That's Ken for you...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I know, right?!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
It wasn't just Ken and his team.
The other artists and watchers all made it a musical town...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I really liked that and finally thought that I'd found the place where I belong.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: And I began singing there around the time I entered junior high.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I didn't know that...
Were you and Tono a team from the start?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
No, it was just me at first.
Tono and I became a team because of this thing that happened during music class.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: During music class?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah. Normally, most people don't like others hearing the way they sing. But he wasn't bothered by that at all.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Not only was he an amazing singer, he had so much presence and clearly knew what he was doing...!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: That was when I thought, “I wanna pursue music with him!” So, I invited him to join me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So Tono sort of already had an aura.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, I've been meaning to ask you this for some time now. What was it like being on a team with him?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: We were just playing around and trying to have fun at first. Compared to you guys, Aoyagi, I can't really say that we were really all that serious.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: But I guess the first day was the hardest. We struggled to come up with a team name.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I mean, he kept saying, “Soma, you should decide,” and didn't seem to want to put any effort into it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Team names... Akito picked the one for our old team, and Azusawa came up with the idea for our current one.)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I thought about it for like three days, and I arrived at an image of us running forward into the wind. And we became Gurney flap.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Running forward...?
It's very you, Soma.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Hm? You think so?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I've been feeling that while helping you write your song. It too seems to embody that sensation.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Oh, haha... Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Actually, we were doing pretty well as a team.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Thanks to Arata, we managed to really get our name out there just after we joined together.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: And Arata's talent exceeded all of my expectations.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
You can't help but call him a genius.
He just has this way of getting the crowd's attention and never letting go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I think I understand...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, I bet. It's kinda hard to tell what he's thinking because he's so loosey-goosey at times, but singing next to him was just something else.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: And our music began to transform right about when we entered high school...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After witnessing RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Yup. It totally changed my life.
That was a truly special event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I only got to see a video of it, but it was easy to tell that there was something special in the air...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You two went together, yes?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
Yup. I invited Arata...
Actually, I kinda had to drag him along...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: By the time we got there, the floor at COL was totally packed and we couldn't make it to the front. So, we had to watch from somewhere in the back.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Then, Nagi came out on stage, but she didn't say anything for what felt like forever. Everyone began wondering what was going on.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
She took a really deep breath...
And turned the place on its head the second she began singing.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: After she finished, I couldn't help but shout and cheer. Everybody at COL was the same way. The building literally shook from all the noise!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
But Arata seemed totally unfazed by it.
Everyone else was going nuts, but he just stood there so quietly...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: We're gonna make this night absolutely legendary, together!!

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I tried calling his name, but he had this expression on his face that I'd never seen before. Not at school or when we were in town. He stared at the stage in complete silence.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: It was the first time I'd seen Arata get so excited about something. I really couldn't believe it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (So that's how Tono experienced RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (However, Nagi and the others performed in a way that set everyone's hearts on fire... At least, that's what I thought...)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Then, at the end, Ken and Taiga took the stage...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
RADder was so awesome.
Way better than when we saw them during that street performance.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: They introduced me to this world and showed me the sorts of things that are possible with music. At the same time, that event made me want to find a way to surpass it.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: I said, “We're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND!” Then, he smiled and said, “Yes, we will.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Oh, Tono said the same thing when we first met him.)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: In a way, it's not my dream to surpass RAD WEEKEND, rather my friend's...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Soma was just like us.
He really wanted to surpass RAD WEEKEND somehow.)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: That night, we started taking things more seriously. It was like our path had become clear and we knew what we had to do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (They knew what they had to do...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That event showed me the life I wanted to lead.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito said the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Hahaha. I mean, he wouldn't be here right now if he didn't feel that way, right? And tons more people were saying the same thing back then.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: You'd hear people all over town saying, “That's gonna be me next!” Everybody everywhere was singing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And you were among them, yes?

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Of course. We decided that we needed to gain more experience. On stage or through street performances, we didn't care.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
We just sang and sang and sang...
And kept on singing.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: We couldn't care less about quality either. We were confident that we needed to sing until our throats wouldn't let us anymore.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, you two must've practiced quite a bit...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Yeah, we were really motivated, but we went a bit overboard sometimes. Looking back, I'm sorta amazed at how much we practiced.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: But I genuinely believed that I'd be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND with Arata by my side.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: And he was absolutely off the hook whenever he got serious! I could feel all the right gears fitting into place as we sang.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That's interesting. It's just like what I experienced. That sensation when...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! That felt great! Not bad, you two!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I think that was the moment I felt it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The first time we sang with Shiraishi and Azusawa in SEKAI... I couldn't believe how well we sang together.)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: We even learned how to write our own tracks, and Arata's performances just kept getting better and better.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Then, we started getting invited to all these events on Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: We were both doing great and always got right back up after getting knocked down. We had a huge tailwind going for us. At least, that's what I thought...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Unfortunately, it didn't last for me...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
We disbanded Gurney flap...
And now, Arata's doing the best he can for the both of us.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: He returned after getting really good, and now he has you guys, Aoyagi! There's nothing for me to worry about!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I appreciate that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Now that I have more information, I think I'm starting to understand how Tono feels after Soma asked him to keep pursuing their dream alone.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But Soma still clearly loves music...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which makes me think that he wants to make his own dream come true...)

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Man, it's already getting dark.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
I'm sorry. I was supposed to be helping you...

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
That's all good.
If anything, I should be the one apologizing. I was supposed to help you learn more about this stuff.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line: Still, it was fun to look back and talk about how Arata and I became a team.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you for that story.
It was nice to learn more about you two.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I hope to learn more about songwriting from you moving forward, Soma.

rows.Speaker: Soma
rows.Line:
You bet...!
And thanks for helping me out today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (My song...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Soma doesn't simply love music.
He's always had a genuine passion for it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which means I need to approach my own music in the same manner. I have to figure out what it is that I'm trying to convey...)
